post.description: Everybody starts here. The BVN is looked up in our own customer table first, then at Caltos (an existing Caltos customer is saved locally and its phone numbers and e-mail are the code options), and only then verified with the BVN provider, after which every phone and e-mail from the BVN record must be unknown to Caltos. It also records privacy-notice consent and returns the masked contacts the code can be sent to plus the resume token. A phone or e-mail that belongs to a different Caltos customer closes the application (409 IDENTITY_DISCREPANCY); Caltos being unreachable is a 503. A returning customer finds their details prefilled later. If the BVN already has an open application it is reopened (`resumed: true`) rather than a new one created; the contact and OTP steps restart so the code is verified again. The resume token is shown once: keep it.

post.description:
Sends a 6-digit code (valid 5 minutes) to ONE masked contact. Asking again within the cooldown returns 429 OTP_RESEND_TOO_SOON with retryAfterSeconds. The first send also runs the Caltos customer lookup.

When the BVN went through Mono (contact ids start with `mono-`, and `masked` is Mono's hint), Mono sends the code to that method and it is checked by Mono when the code is verified; the session lasts 10 minutes (410 BVN_SESSION_EXPIRED afterwards: enter the BVN again). For the `mono-alternate_phone` contact, send `phoneNumber` too.

post.description: Creates the DigiSign request for the locked offer (the offer letter as a PDF in Princeps' template) and returns `signingUrl`, the DigiSign page where the customer holds up their ID, reads the lines aloud and signs. Open it for the customer, then poll GET /identity (DigiSign's callbacks also prompt a read). Calling it again returns the open request; a changed offer gets a new one. The customer needs an e-mail (profile step): DigiSign also sends the link there. DigiSign is an alternative to uploading a selfie holding the ID and the terms video: either confirms the customer. If DigiSign is not set up on the server this answers 503 DIGISIGN_NOT_CONFIGURED (see `digisignAvailable` on GET /identity and GET /documents).

info.title: Princeps Self-Service API
info.description:
Borrower loan application API (v2). BVN first; eligibility from the salary source decides the loans offered; Caltos prices every offer and remains the final loan system.

Steps are reported as DONE or PENDING, not enforced.

Document uploads use a short-lived S3 PUT URL. The returned fileUrl is a stable self-service capability URL and is the link forwarded to Caltos.

applicationResumeToken.name: x-application-resume-token
applicationResumeToken.description: Opaque token returned by POST /api/v2/applications. Keep it private; it authorizes access to one resumable application.

code.description: SUCCESS, or the machine-readable error code (for example APPLICATION_CLOSED, OTP_INVALID, VALIDATION_ERROR).

data.description: The response payload. On errors, any extra detail (attemptsLeft, retryAfterSeconds, reasons, validation errors), or {}.

code.description: Machine-readable code the UI branches on.

message.example: You are not eligible for a loan right now.

reasons.description: Some errors add fields next to `code`: reasons, retryAfterSeconds, attemptsLeft, missing, accountName, maxAmountForTenor, ...

name.example: Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps

step.description: 1-based position of the step in the suggested order (bvn = 1 ... submit = 14). Informational only: steps are guidance and are not enforced.

startedAt.description: When work on the step began. Absent until the step has been started.

doneAt.description: Present when DONE. For bvn this is when the OTP was verified.

verification.description: BVN, choosing a contact and verifying the code, as one step. DONE once the code is verified.

accountName.description: Name returned by the bank lookup.

accountNumberMasked.description: The full number is never returned.

source.description: Which salary source produced the result.

schedule.description: Repayment schedule rows as returned by Caltos. Empty on quotes; filled once the offer is selected.

reference.description: Set once the application is submitted.

suggestedNext.description: The first PENDING step, or null when everything is done.

returningCustomer.description: True when BVN matched a customer who has applied before.

contacts.description: Only until the code has been verified.

offer.description: After the code is verified and an offer is chosen.

resumeToken.description: Send as x-application-resume-token on every later call. Shown once.

resumed.description: True when this BVN had an open application that was reopened instead of a new one. The contact and OTP steps are PENDING again, and the previous resume token no longer works.

consent.description: The applicant agreed to the Privacy Notice.

noticeVersion.description: Version of the Privacy Notice shown.

reference.description: Set once the application is submitted.

suggestedNext.description: The first PENDING step, or null when everything is done.

returningCustomer.description: True when BVN matched a customer who has applied before.

contacts.description: Only until the code has been verified.

offer.description: After the code is verified and an offer is chosen.

resendAfterSeconds.description: Seconds before another code can be requested.

devCode.description: Only outside production and only when OTP_DEBUG_ECHO is on.

contactId.description: Contact id from the masked contact list.

phoneNumber.description: Only for a contact whose method is alternate_phone (BVN lookup through Mono): the number the code goes to.

mandatesNeedingRevocation.description: Mandates that already exist at a provider. They are marked STOPPED here but are not revoked at the provider.

reason.example: I no longer need the loan.
reason.description: Optional, kept with the application. Up to 500 characters.

name.description: From the BVN record. Not editable.

profile.description: Saved values, else earlier details, else the BVN record.

done.description: True once the profile has been saved.

mdaCode.description: Required for state: the MDA code from GET /v2/mdas.

employerId.description: Required for paramilitary: an employer id from GET /v2/paramilitary/employers, or "other".

monthsLeftInService.description: Required for nysc: months left in service (1-11).

nameMatchesBvn.description: False means saving this account will be rejected with ACCOUNT_NAME_MISMATCH.

serviceNumber.description: Required for paramilitary, and for state MDAs verified through Dedukt (staff or service number).

pendingSteps.description: Steps reported as still pending after submission.

loanId.description: Caltos loan id once the loan exists.

productId.description: Use as productId in quote and select.

maxAmount.description: The most this customer can take on this product.

calculation.description: Priced at the suggested amount and default tenor.

expiresAt.description: The result is locked until then.

manualReview.description: True when the application will be sent for manual review.

eligible.description: false means the amount or tenor is not allowed; see `reason`.

maxAmountForTenor.description: The most they can take at this tenor, so the slider can snap.

productId.description: Product id from the eligibility offers.

identityDone.description: "Confirm it is you" is done by uploading both identityRequired documents OR by verifying through DigiSign. True once either has happened; identityMissing is then empty.

digisignAvailable.description: DigiSign is configured and switched on, so POST /identity/start can be used instead of the two uploads.

uploadHeaders.description: Send these headers unchanged with the PUT.

expiresIn.description: Seconds the upload URL stays valid.

status.description: The document lists after this upload.

digisignAvailable.description: DigiSign is configured and switched on. When false, only the selfie with ID and the terms video can be used.

status.description: PENDING: the customer has to finish on the DigiSign page. REVIEW: DigiSign flagged the signing and a reviewer is looking. FAILED: the request was rejected, expired or voided; start again.

done.description: True once the customer is confirmed, by DigiSign (for the offer they hold; a changed offer needs a new check) or by the two uploads.

via.description: How the customer was confirmed, once done.

signingUrl.description: Open this for the customer while PENDING.

hash.description: Identifies this exact version; send it back to accept.
The hash returned with the letter being accepted.

actionUrl.description: Open this so the customer can approve.

complete.description: True when every required mandate is ACTIVE.
